incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (region: us-west-2)
incident-bot: metric p99 latency crossed 2s threshold across dedicated pool A at 2026-03-15T08:27:46Z
maria: saw the spike, paging on-call now. p95 doubled in last 12m.
devon: I'm oncall, joining. what's the model variant + recent deploys?
maria: precision-tune job deployed 08:15 UTC to int8-profile on dedicated GPU pool A. Canaries looked fine initially.
sre_lead: rolling p99 increase coincides with the quant-profile switch — suspect int8 kernel path + KV dequant contention under streaming workloads.
ops_tara: customer impact: a small set of interactive streaming sessions reported repeated stalls and partial responses. CS is getting tickets.
cs_jim: several paying customers reporting choppy streaming and timeouts in chat flows. IDs: C-342, C-118. escalating.
eng_kevin: grabbing deploy logs now. seeing calibration job emit warnings: "quant-tune: outlier_layers=3 dequant_retries=5". stack traces attached to logs.
eng_kevin: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T08:16:03Z] quant-deploy: profile int8: started rollout -> pool A
[2026-03-15T08:26:54Z] kv-cache: dequant-fallback triggered for 7% requests
[2026-03-15T08:27:40Z] tail-latency: streaming chunk delay spike > 600ms
```
oncall-bot: @devon, you have been paged (severity: high) — acknowledge with `ack`.
devon: ack. assigning triage owners: eng_kevin (engine), sre_lead (runtime), ops_tara (customer comms).
sre_lead: quick hypothesis: int8 path increased L2 dequant ops under certain attention patterns, causing kernel thread contention in the runtime multiplexor. streaming stalls appear when KV cache dequant requests block execution.
eng_kevin: mitigation plan: 1) roll back quant-profile on pool A to fp16 at 08:40 UTC 2) enable routing fallback to fp16 variant for streaming endpoints 3) apply temporary per-route concurrency cap to reduce pressure.
maria: can we do a rolling rollback without full redeploy? use hotpatch? devon?
devon: yes — issuing hotpatch rollback to pool A now. command:
```
redwoodctl runtime hotpatch rollback --pool=dedicated-A --profile=int8->fp16 --reason="p99 spike"
```
devon: hotpatch acked. starting routing override to route streaming to fp16 fallback for customers with streaming:true.
eng_kevin: also disabling aggressive KV prefetch for streaming on pool A to avoid dequant thrash.
ops_tara: CS notified customers in queue with a short status template. posting update in the support portal.
cs_jim: template sent; customers acknowledged and some switched to non-streaming fallback endpoint as workaround.
maria: metrics snapshot: p95 210ms -> 480ms, p99 680ms -> 2.9s at peak. after rollback in progress, p99 dropping to ~900ms.
sre_lead: watch stall-rate (% of streaming requests with >500ms chunk delay). pre-incident: 0.2% -> incident: 4.6% -> after mitigation: 0.7%.
eng_kevin: leaving logs & flamegraphs in /tmp/quant-incident/3236543210 for postmortem. short-term plan: revert canary, add extra layer-level calibration checks, and add a slow-path circuit breaker for dequant retries.
devon: follow-up actions (owners): eng_kevin -> postmortem + calibration-safety gating; sre_lead -> runtime throttles + observability alert tuning; ops_tara -> customer recap; maria -> coordinate dedicated rollback audit.
oncall-bot: incident severity downgraded to medium, paging cleared.
ops_tara: closing loop — C-342 reported service restored; C-118 still validating. will escalate to support if not green in 30m.
maria: thanks everyone. scheduling postmortem 14:00 UTC to review quant rollout gating and add canary traffic-shape tests.
